My primary symptom: Progressively worsening diffuse abdominal pain, distension and nausea.

How long has this been going on (hours/days/weeks), and has the pain come in waves (crampy/colicky) or is it constant?

Also, are you still passing gas and having bowel movements, or have they decreased/stopped (and any vomiting—especially green/bilious or feculent)?

message.content: I’m not sure exactly how many days this has been going on, but it has been getting steadily worse. The pain feels constant rather than coming in waves. I have been feeling very nauseous, but I don't remember if I've actually vomited. To be honest, I’m not sure about my bowel movements or if I’m still passing gas; I haven't really been paying attention to that.
